title: astragalus ceratoides var. campestris
intro: Astragalus ceratoides var. campestris, commonly known as the alpine milk vetch, is a perennial legume plant belonging to the Astragalus genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include immune system support, anti-inflammatory properties, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus ceratoides var. campestris include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
